title: Events
description:

Factory is hiring for our Events team to own the strategy, creative development, production, and execution of our highest-profile and most complex event experiences.

This role owns a focused portfolio of large-scale programs that represent significant investments in Factory's brand, employees, customers, and market presence - including Sales Kickoff, President's Club, major industry conferences such as AWS re:Invent, and high-impact experiential activations surrounding Tier-1 industry events.

This role will be working in close partnership with the Head of Events, Field Marketing, Marketing, and external agency and production partners, you will serve as the executive producer for these programs - from initial concept and business objectives through budgeting, creative development, production, onsite execution, and post-event measurement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Own end-to-end strategy and production for Factory's flagship event portfolio, including:

- Sales Kickoff (SKO)

- President's Club

- Tier-1 conferences and trade shows such as AWS re:Invent

- Major sponsored experiences and experiential activations

- Translate company and business objectives into distinctive event strategies and attendee experiences that strengthen Factory's brand and support measurable business outcomes.

- Serve as Executive Producer for flagship programs, establishing the creative vision, production approach, operating plan, budget, timeline, and attendee journey.

- Lead large-scale presence at major industry moments such as AWS re:Invent, including booth experiences, sponsorships, customer programming, hospitality, offsite activations, executive participation, and surrounding brand experiences.

- Own multimillion-dollar event budgets and provide forecasting, reconciliation, scenario planning, and recommendations for maximizing investment.

- Source, negotiate with, and lead external agencies, production companies, venues, DMCs, experiential partners, AV/technical production teams, and specialty vendors.

- Lead complex cross-functional workstreams involving Marketing, Brand, Sales, Product, Communications, People, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership.

- Establish detailed production plans, critical paths, RACI structures, run-of-show documentation, contingency plans, and onsite operating models.

- Lead onsite production and serve as the senior decision-maker for flagship event execution.

- Develop premium attendee experiences appropriate for employees, customers, executives, partners, and VIP audiences.

- Identify opportunities to extend Factory's presence beyond the primary conference environment through sponsored events, hospitality, experiential activations, and strategic partnerships.

- Partner with the team on annual planning, budget allocation, event standards, measurement, and long-term evolution of Factory's event portfolio.

- Establish scalable processes, vendor relationships, production standards, and best practices that can be leveraged across the broader events organization.

- Conduct post-event analysis and translate results, stakeholder feedback, attendee insights, and operational learnings into recommendations for future programs.

- Champion the Factory voice and ensure every program reflects the ambition of our mission to bring autonomy to software engineering.

- Experience owning end-to-end strategy and production for large-scale, high-complexity events such as sales kickoffs, user conferences, President's Club, or Tier-1 industry conferences and sponsorships.

- Experience at a high-growth startup or hyper-growth technology company is strongly preferred.

- Proven track record serving as executive producer for flagship programs, from concept and budgeting through onsite execution and post-event measurement.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
At Staris AI we believe human-based cyber defense is dead and the dream of security automation is finally within reach. Staris AI is a Series A ventured-backed firm that is reinventing application security with its innovative AI-powered penetration testing that continuously validates and remediates real attack paths in running applications. The Staris Total Context Security platform proves exploitable vulnerabilities in hours, not weeks, with zero false positives and 40:1 efficiency gains over traditional methods.

We're on a mission to transform the indefensible into the impenetrable, advancing applications into a new era of security.

As a Staris Sales Engineer, your singular focus is the successful conversion of interest into an actionable proof-of-concept, showing customers what is possible when Staris is integrated directly into their stack. You’ll partner cross functionally with both our sales and engineering teams, reducing “time to value” and increasing usage adoption of our solutions. This is a high-impact, high-accountability, and high-autonomy position.

What You'll Do

• Own the technical Proof of Concept journey end-to-end, from initial discovery and live demonstrations through successful enterprise deployments providing measurable security outcomes in complex customer technology environments.

• Act as a trusted advisor to security and engineering leaders, enabling strategic conversations around application security, AI-driven assessment, and technology transformation.

• Architect integrations across CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, identity systems, and network security controls to operationalize autonomous security assessments in customer workflows.

• Leverage exposure to diverse technology environments and maturity models to uncover patterns, inform product direction, and influence the future of AI-powered security validation.

• Ensure customers are successful post-sale through onboarding guidance, technical troubleshooting, and hands-on partnership during early adoption.

What You Bring

• Experience with application security testing and best practices

• Experience supporting a B2B sales motion

• Experience with AI software solutions.

• Experience with large enterprise customers

• Experience in collaborating on whitepapers, blogs, and other thought leadership

• Strong English language communication skills

• A Bachelor's degree.

Why Staris

• Backed by a founding team with deep pedigree, including alumni of Amazon, Accenture, and Palo Alto Networks, who have solved this problem operationally before.

• A genuine category-defining product. Most AppSec tools create noise while Staris eliminates it with AI-driven proof of exploitability and automated, code-level remediation.

• Selling into a massive, underserved market. Enterprises invest heavily in AppSec but deeply test only a fraction of their software portfolio.

• Competitive base and uncapped commission, meaningful equity, full benefits, and a remote-first culture.

title: Plumbing Engineer
description:
Miller-Remick is a full-service MEP engineering firm looking for energetic, self-motivated, and innovative individuals to join our team. If you think you are a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Plumbing Engineer will support multiple concurrent capital projects ranging from $5M - $100M across a variety of markets, with a strong focus on healthcare. This person should have a proven history of performing work with efficiency and periodic oversight.
Our clients include federal agencies (e.g. Department of Veteran Affairs, Department of Defense, General Services Administration, and the Federal Bureau of Prisons), as well as state and local governments. Projects have varied degrees of complexity and a wide range of estimated construction costs and include new construction and renovations of hospitals, healthcare and military facilities, federal office buildings and courthouses, state and local government buildings, research laboratories, corrections facilities and site utility infrastructure projects.
Key Responsibilities

• Prepare plumbing designs, calculations, estimates, reports, and specifications for building projects

• Support plumbing design on multiple projects, working off established priorities

• Conduct site surveys of existing conditions

• Assist with construction punch lists

• Participate in project design and coordination meetings

• Communicate with all other disciplines to ensure incorporation of all information into project requirements

• Accountable for technical quality of engineering tasks on assigned projects

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field, and/or a credential such as CPD (Certified in Plumbing Design), and/or equivalent experience; Progress toward PE licensure is preferred

• Minimum 5 years of related experience designing wide variety of facilities for industrial, commercial, educational, institutional and governmental projects

• Experience in hospitals and healthcare, military bases, government buildings and courthouses, research laboratories, central steam and chilled water plants, and/or corrections facilities highly valued

• Strong Revit skills

• Good planning, organizational, and communication skills

• Experience with plumbing systems including sanitary, storm, domestic water, and natural gas is required

• Exposure to fire protection systems (wet/dry/pre-action sprinklers and standpipes) is a plus

• Ability to work on multiple projects at the same time

• Travel to client sites as required

Miller-Remick does not provide visa sponsorship or support. Candidates are required to successfully complete a federal background check for security clearance.
The anticipated salary range for this position is $99,400 - $113,600 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including experience, qualifications, education, certifications and licensure.

About Miller-Remick

We are a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business committed to supporting our brave military and veterans through a comprehensive array of consulting engineering and construction management services with a focus on leadership, quality, and responsiveness.

In addition to a competitive salary, our employees enjoy a full benefit package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k with matching, PTO, and 12 paid holidays. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at .

We are an equal opportunity employer. We provide reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law.

title: Logistics Engineer

ABOUT THE TEAM

GenAI Engineering sits within Motorway's Data and AI function, alongside Machine Learning and the Machine Learning Data Platform. We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to build AI applications and agentic workflows for Motorway, taking them from rapid prototype through to production-grade systems that deliver measurable value.

title: Staff Robotics Engineer, 3D Sensing
description:
About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The role 

Wayve is seeking a Staff Robotics Engineer, 3D Sensing to lead the technical development of our LiDAR and cross-sensor 3D sensing capabilities. You will own the systems used to calibrate, synchronise and align LiDARs with cameras and other vehicle sensors, enabling accurate and reliable 3D data for perception, reconstruction and ground-truth generation.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for shaping the architecture and technical roadmap for 3D sensing, while remaining deeply involved in algorithm development, implementation, evaluation and deployment. You will solve challenging problems arising from real sensor systems-including imperfect time synchronisation, rolling-shutter cameras and LiDAR sweep patterns-and develop robust methods that operate across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions. You will collaborate broadly across Wayve and provide technical leadership and mentorship across the 3D sensing stack.

Key responsibilities:

• Define and evolve the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s LiDAR and cross-sensor 3D sensing capabilities, aligned with product and vehicle-programme requirements.

• Lead the development of target-based and targetless LiDAR calibration and registration methods, including LiDAR-to-camera alignment using geometric and learned approaches.

• Develop robust temporal alignment and motion compensation methods using techniques such as LiDAR odometry, nonlinear least-squares optimisation and factor graphs.

• Establish evaluation methodologies and productionise reliable, scalable 3D sensing systems that operate across diverse vehicles, environments and sensor configurations.

• Work with engineering and research teams to deliver end-to-end 3D sensing capabilities, while providing technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers.

About you   

In order to set you up for success as a Staff Robotics Engineer, 3D Sensing at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience:

Essential 

• Significant experience developing robotics or autonomous-driving systems involving LiDAR, cameras and 3D sensor data.

• Strong experience with target-based or targetless sensor calibration and registration, including LiDAR-to-camera alignment.

• Strong understanding of 3D geometry, state estimation and optimisation techniques, including nonlinear least-squares methods or factor graphs.

• Experience accounting for sensor timing and motion effects, such as time synchronisation, LiDAR sweep distortion, rolling-shutter cameras and motion compensation.

• Strong software-engineering skills in C++ and/or Python, with experience taking robotics algorithms from prototype through evaluation and production deployment.

• Experience defining evaluation methodologies, datasets and metrics for assessing calibration, registration and 3D sensing quality across real-world conditions.

description:
Position Summary
The Construction Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, monitoring, and updating project schedules to support the successful delivery of construction projects. This position works closely with project managers, superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients to establish realistic project timelines, track progress, identify potential delays, and support timely project completion.
The Construction Scheduler plays a key role in providing accurate schedule information to the project team and management, identifying schedule risks, and supporting recovery plans when projects fall behind schedule.
Key Responsibilities
Project Scheduling

• Develop detailed baseline schedules for construction projects in accordance with contract requirements and project objectives.

• Create and maintain project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout activities as applicable.

• Develop activity sequences, durations, logic relationships, milestones, and critical path activities.

• Coordinate schedule development with project managers, superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders.

• Ensure schedules accurately reflect project scope, contract requirements, and planned construction methods.

• Establish and maintain appropriate schedule coding, calendars, work breakdown structures, and activity classifications.
Schedule Updates & Progress Tracking

• Update project schedules regularly based on actual field progress and information provided by the project team.

• Collect and verify progress information from field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.

• Track actual start and finish dates, remaining durations, percentage complete, quantities, and milestones.

• Compare planned progress against actual progress and identify variances.

• Maintain accurate records of schedule changes, revisions, and project milestones.
Schedule Analysis

• Monitor the critical path and near-critical activities.

• Identify potential delays, schedule risks, and impacts to project milestones.

• Perform schedule variance and trend analysis.

• Evaluate the impact of changes, RFIs, submittals, procurement issues, design changes, weather events, and other factors affecting the schedule.

• Provide recommendations to the project team regarding schedule mitigation and recovery strategies.

• Assist with time-impact analysis and extension-of-time evaluations when required.
Coordination & Reporting

• Work closely with project management and field operations to ensure schedule information reflects current project conditions.

• Participate in project coordination, progress, and scheduling meetings.

• Prepare weekly and monthly schedule reports for project management and clients.

• Provide schedule updates, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and critical-path analyses.

• Communicate schedule changes and potential impacts to relevant project stakeholders.

• Assist project managers and superintendents with short-term planning and sequencing.
Look-Ahead Planning

• Develop and maintain detailed short-term and look-ahead schedules.

• Coordinate upcoming activities with field supervision and subcontractors.

• Identify constraints that could prevent planned work from progressing.

• Track required materials, manpower, equipment, inspections, approvals, and other prerequisites.

• Assist the project team in developing recovery schedules when required.
Change Management

• Incorporate approved change orders, design changes, scope changes, and other modifications into project schedules.

• Assess schedule impacts associated with changes and delays.

• Maintain a clear record of schedule revisions and changes to key milestones.

• Coordinate with project controls and commercial teams regarding schedule impacts on cost and contract requirements.

HubSpot offers a flexible, supportive environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career:

description:

About Us
Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.

Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.

We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.

About the role
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team within Platform Intelligence.

Platform Intelligence develops the data infrastructure, machine learning, geospatial pipelines, and technical systems behind Revalue's nature and carbon intelligence products. We turn scientific and analytical work into repeatable, reliable outputs: ingesting and validating Earth observation datasets, producing the analyses and baselines that underpin our carbon methodologies, designing monitoring systems, and running the cloud platform underneath.

This role is about moving from analytical and ML prototypes to production-grade systems. You will work closely with engineers, data scientists, and analysts to build data pipelines, productionise models, and improve reproducibility, making workflows maintainable, observable, and usable by others.

Some of the most important work is deciding what to build, how to model it, and where to draw boundaries. You will work with domain experts to make those decisions rather than simply implementing predefined specifications.

It is a hands-on role at the boundary between software engineering, data science, geospatial engineering, and cloud infrastructure. You will not be expected to lead scientific model development, but you will make sure the models run reliably in production.

Who we are looking for
Please note: Candidates must have existing authorisation to work in Indonesia.

A strong mid-level or senior individual contributor who can own delivery independently and turn complex technical workflows into stable production systems.

Key skills:

• Strong software engineering background. Design, interface, contract, data and domain modeling.

• Scientific programming background in any domain: geospatial, remote sensing, ML, signal/audio/vision, quant, simulation, bioinformatics. We care more about the pattern of experience rather than the specific domain: translating messy, abstract, real-world structures into correct data representations and transformations.

• Comfortable across stacks and tools: generalist disposition, able to pick up new languages/frameworks as our needs shift.

• Familiar with modern SWE practices and product-engineering: discovery, scoping, iterative and incremental delivery, comfortable operating in ambiguity.

Hard skills:

• Good engineering practice: testing, code review, CI/CD, modular design, documentation.

• Experience productionising analytical, data science, or ML workflows: turning exploratory code into reliable systems, with a working understanding of batch processing, reproducibility, monitoring, and deployment.

• Day-to-day work is in scientific Python. However, we weigh fundamentals and data aptitude above prior Python experience: if you have done this kind of work in C++, Scala, … , that counts.

• Cloud engineering experience, ideally on GCP and AWS, including designing and operating cloud-based data systems.

• A pragmatic mindset: knowing when to build carefully, when to simplify, and when to avoid unnecessary complexity.

Soft skills:

• Comfortable with high-visibility, shared-ownership, collaborative work: pairing on decisions, small trunk-based commits, and real-time feedback on work in progress.

• Comfortable running discovery sessions with domain experts before building.

title: Senior Manager, Security Operations - Detection Engineering & Incident Response
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the Senior Manager of Security Operations, you will lead and scale Everpure's global Detection Engineering and Cloud Incident Detection & Response (CIDR) teams. You will own the mission of transforming SecOps into a proactive, intelligence-driven defense engine that measurably reduces risk across cloud, SaaS, infrastructure, and endpoint environments. Partnering closely with GRC, Infrastructure, Product Security, and Engineering leadership, you will establish operational work plans, detection standards, and response strategies that safeguard the Everpure Platform against sophisticated global threats.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Direct Detection Engineering & Incident Response Strategy: Establish operational objectives, work plans, and SLAs across threat detection, automated response workflows, and incident triage to continuously optimize Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).

•
Champion Threat-Informed Detection & Validation: Lead the deployment and continuous refinement of a high-signal detection inventory mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, validating control efficacy through automated simulations, red/purple team exercises, and threat hunt findings.

•
Streamline Telemetry Ingestion & Automation: Oversee the architectural ingestion of multi-cloud (AWS, Azure), endpoint, network, and SaaS log sources into SIEM and SOAR pipelines, reducing false positives and accelerating automated remediation.

•
Lead Executive Incident Governance & Postmortems: Direct major incident response efforts, oversee root-cause analyses, and translate complex security metrics into actionable executive dashboards and board-level risk reports that drive cross-functional remediation.

•
Manage & Develop SecOps Engineering Teams: Direct resource allocation, budget priorities, and professional development across multiple specialized security squads, cultivating a high-performing team culture focused on operational excellence.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
SecOps & Incident Leadership Expertise: Proven track record of leading and scaling enterprise security operations, detection engineering, and incident response functions across hybrid cloud and SaaS environments.

•
Advanced Technical & Telemetry Mastery: Deep technical command of SIEM and SOAR platforms, EDR solutions, cloud telemetry architectures, and detection-as-code principles integrated with modern CI/CD pipelines.

•
Threat Modeling & Governance Savvy: Comprehensive mastery of threat-informed defense methodologies, MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping, and control validation through atomic testing and threat hunting.

•
Executive Communication & Cross-Functional Influence: Demonstrated ability to interact with executive leadership, navigate complex risk discussions with Infrastructure and Engineering teams, and align technical posture with business priorities.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Prelim

Prelim builds digital account-opening infrastructure for community banks and credit unions. We've sustained over 100% ARR growth for four consecutive years on seed funding, and our platform sits in the critical path of how banks onboard their customers. When our system is down, a bank can't open accounts for its customers.
We're a small team. You'd be our first dedicated DevOps hire, which means you'll own infrastructure end to end.
What you'll own

• Own the build, test, and deploy pipeline. Our engineers ship fast; your job is to make shipping fast and safe: progressive rollouts, fast rollbacks, deploy confidence.

• Make and enforce our infrastructure as fully reproducible environments via code.

• Define and hit uptime targets our bank customers contractually depend on. Build out monitoring, alerting, and incident response so we find problems before our customers do. Mature our on-call practice from heroics into a system.

• We sell to regulated financial institutions. Change management, access controls, and audit logging need to produce evidence, not just exist. You'll partner closely with our security function on our ongoing SOC 2 and bank due-diligence requirements.

• Own the cloud bill. Growth shouldn't mean linear infrastructure spend.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years in DevOps / SRE / platform engineering roles; experience as an early or solo infra hire strongly preferred

• Deep fluency with a major cloud provider (AWS) and infrastructure-as-code in production

• You've built CI/CD pipelines other engineers loved, not just tolerated

• Strong opinions on observability. You've instrumented systems, defined SLOs, and run incident processes

• Comfortable operating in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment, or eager to learn what that demands (SOC 2, ISO 27001)

• You default to automation and mechanisms over manual process, and you document what you build

• Pragmatic: you can tell the difference between what a 50-person company needs now and what a 400-person company needs later

Nice to have

• Fintech, banking, or other regulated-industry experience

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture

• Database operations experience (backups, migrations, performance)

• Security-adjacent skills: secrets management, network segmentation, least-privilege IAM

Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
description:
WHY BACKEND ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

- Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals - and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

- Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

- Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

- Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR INFRASTRUCTURE

- From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution https://langfuse.com/blog/2024-12-langfuse-v3-infrastructure-evolution - deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

- Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXYQ5odATrM - recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

- Architecture https://langfuse.com/handbook/product-engineering/architecture

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

- You get excited when working with a ton of data

- Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

- You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

Bonus points:

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's accounts/projects/credits while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies

- Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend

- Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.

- Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)

- Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints

- Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build

- Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus

- You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do

- Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets

- Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)

- Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)

- Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:

- Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin

- Frontend: React and Typescript

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase

- Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery

- DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

description:
Join the global community that enhances and elevates the experience of the most prestigious luxury brands in the world! CXG , a leading customer experience agency servicing premium and luxury brands, is looking for mission-based Customer Experience Evaluators who are existing luxury brand customers.
As a Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator, you can perform several evaluations per month and provide your valuable feedback via a questionnaire. Your assignments will be as diverse as our luxury clients and industries, ranging from fashion and high-end jewelry to cosmetics, luxury watches, automotives, and more. Your evaluations may involve visiting a store, returning a purchase, buying a product online, or making an appointment with a store.
Please note: Applicants should not have worked for luxury retail brands to ensure the integrity and objectivity of the evaluations.
Your feedback can influence brand strategies and help shape a brand's strategy, making this an opportunity for you to have a meaningful impact on the luxury market.
Responsibilities:

• Conduct discreet evaluations of your favorite luxury brands in-store, online, or sometimes both.

• Provide objective feedback about your experiences.

• Choose assignments that align with your profile and interests.

• Complete questionnaires after each evaluation.

• Comply with all given project objectives and special requirements from the luxury brand we represent

How to Apply:
To become an evaluator with us, follow these simple steps:

• Register on live.cxg.com and receive an email with your credentials.

• Log into our platform and tell us more about yourself. Once this is done, our team will verify your profile and contact you.

• Check the ‘welcome package’ and pass the general certification.

• You’re now ready! You are now available for assignments and can browse and apply for any opportunities that interest you.

About CXG :
CXG is a global customer experience agency servicing premium and luxury brands. Our 12 offices around the world are able to service 70 countries. We are a team of 220+ customer experience experts and a network of over 80,000 evaluators worldwide. Learn more about what we do at .
Enjoy the flexibility of working from our mobile application where you can search and apply for missions, take certifications, submit surveys, and much more, all on the go.
Contact us for more information!
Requirements

• Must be 18 years or older.

• Existing client of premium and luxury brands.

• Not contractually engaged with any retail brands, to maintain integrity.

• Punctual, organized, detail-oriented, reliable.

• Observant, passionate about customer experience.

• No prior experience needed, we look for honest feedback from real customers.

description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to ensure the security and integrity of Beacon AI’s systems and data across commercial and Department of Defense (DoD) environments. This is a hands-on security engineering role focused on designing and operating secure systems, partnering closely with software teams, and protecting mission-critical flight safety technology while meeting applicable security and compliance standards, including FedRAMP and DoD Impact Level (IL) requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design and implement secure architectures across applications, cloud infrastructure, backend services, and in-cockpit edge systems, including environments built to FedRAMP Moderate baseline and DoD IL4/IL5 environments.

- Protect sensitive data through strong controls for access management, encryption, and secure data handling, consistent with NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171 requirements.

- Identify, assess, and mitigate security risks through vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security reviews.

- Lead incident response efforts, including detection, containment, remediation, and follow-up analysis.

- Integrate security into the SDLC by partnering with software teams on threat modeling, secure code review, and automated security checks in CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code.

- Implement and operate security monitoring and logging to detect and respond to threats in real time.

- Support authorization and compliance efforts (ATO packages, SSPs, POA&Ms) for FedRAMP and DoD accreditation processes.

- Help maintain CMMC 2.0 readiness and alignment with DFARS cybersecurity clauses across the environment.

- Secure our AI systems, including LLM and retrieval-based features, against risks like prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering roles securing complex systems and data, including production cloud environments (AWS or AWS GovCloud strongly preferred)

- Strong knowledge of security principles, threat modeling, and defensive security practices.

- Experience with common security tools and technologies (e.g., SIEM, IDS/IPS, vulnerability scanning, encryption).

- Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST 800-53/800-171, ISO 27001, and CMMC.

- Direct experience with FedRAMP authorization processes (ATO, SSP, POA&M) and/or DoD Impact Level (IL4/IL5) environments.

- Comfort being an early security owner: setting priorities, building from scratch, and balancing risk against a fast-moving product roadmap.

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers on secure system design.

- Hands-on mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

BONUS POINTS

- Passion for aviation and a desire to improve air travel efficiency and safety.

- Experience working with aviation, aerospace, or DoD customers, particularly in ITAR-controlled environments.

- Familiarity with zero trust architectures or advanced security approaches.

- Experience with StateRAMP, IL5/IL6 systems, or classified/controlled unclassified information (CUI) handling.

- Experience securing mobile (iOS), embedded, or edge devices operating in disconnected or constrained environments.

- Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CEH.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

• Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

• Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

• Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey. 

Our impact thus far:

• 205k+ learners since 2021

• 117k youth in work

• 13k youth starting own ventures

• 66k youth in jobs through entrepreneurship
